text:
Anya PMM: Quick sync — we need a compact routing + messaging map for the upcoming partner webinar. goal = align bench claims + SDR scripts by deal stage.
Sam Content: +1. can we make 1-pager for SDRs and 1-pager for AEs? short soundbites only. :memo:
Jordan SalesOps: For routing: MQL -> SDR inbox; SQL (meeting booked) -> AE queue; >$250k ARR interest -> enterprise-routing. want rules in plain text so ops can implement.
Marta GTM: Suggested claim tiers tied to funnel: awareness (latency/cost story), evaluation (bench numbers + integration ease), decision (SLA/isolated infra). Keep bullets.
Rebecca Growth: Also include a 30s webinar opening line for marketing landing page. e.g., "Redwood makes inference predictable at scale — lower token cost, consistent latency, and plug-and-play private deploys." keep options.
Anya PMM: Drafting mapping now. thinking table like: DEAL_STAGE -> PRIMARY CLAIM -> SDR HOOK -> AE HANDOFF CHECKLIST. example:
```
MQL -> "Lower per-token economics via batching & KV caching" -> "Curious how you price per inference? we usually cut token cost by ~30% with batching" -> ask: "workload size + latency SLO?"
EVAL -> "Verified latency profiles: p95 20-40ms lower vs public endpoints in our tests" -> "We ran your sample prompt set; results show more stable p95s. Want the report?" -> handoff: attach eval report link + model pins
BUY -> "Dedicated pools + private control plane for regulated workloads" -> "We can reserve capacity and put you in a VPC in X weeks" -> handoff: legal/reg checklist
```
Jordan SalesOps: perfect. For ops implementable rules: include fields: trigger, destination, priority, owner. Example: `trigger: demo-booked & ARR>=250k -> dest: enterprise-AE -> priority: high -> owner: sales-ops`
Sam Content: I'll compress wording into 2-3 alternate hooks per claim so SDRs can A/B. Also adding quick objection handlers. e.g., objection: "we already use cloud A" -> reply: "Most teams start there; but when cost/latency matters we help with predictable SLOs + fallbacks."
Marta GTM: We should call out competitor differentiators in one-liners: vs managed cloud endpoints (predictable latency+fallbacks), vs LLM APIs (cost + private deploy), vs infra vendors (turnkey runtime + ops tooling). One-liners only.
Rebecca Growth: For landing page CTA variants: "Run a free eval on your prompt set" vs "See p95 and cost delta on your workload" — test both.
Anya PMM: Need two deliverables by EOD Thur: 1) single-page routemap (ops-friendly) 2) SDR 1-pager with hooks + 3 scripts. Anyone blocking?
Jordan SalesOps: No blockers. I'll draft implementable JSON rules for infra.
Sam Content: I'll finish SDR scripts and 30s webinar open.
Marta GTM: I'll write the competitor one-liners and the AE checklist for handoff.
Rebecca Growth: I'll prepare the landing CTA variants and set up an experiment in GA.
webinar-bot: Reminder: Webinar rehearsal scheduled Thu 10:00 PST. :loudspeaker:
Anya PMM: Great — let's post drafts in #marketing by Wed EOD for feedback. tagging @Sam Content @Jordan SalesOps @Marta GTM @Rebecca Growth. :rocket:
